## 2. Product & Solution Architecture

### 2.1 Enterprise ERP & Wholesale Inventory
- **Multi-Branch & Multi-Warehouse:** Real-time inter-branch stock transfers with status tracking (Pending, In-Transit, Received, Discrepancy Flagged).
- **Landed Cost Accounting:** Accurately apportions freight, customs clearance, packaging, and duties to calculate true inventory unit cost and gross margin.
- **Supplier Ledgers & AP/AR:** Full double-entry style accounting tracking invoices, partial payments, credit notes, returned merchandise (RMA), and vendor balance aging.
- **Dynamic Pricing Engine:** Multi-tiered pricing structure supporting Retail, Wholesale Tier 1, Wholesale Tier 2, and Partner Contract Pricing with automated volume discount thresholds.

### 2.2 Offline-First Mobile Point of Sale (POS)
- **Local-First Architecture:** Complete client-side caching of catalog, inventory indices, and customer records using IndexedDB/SQLite.
- **Crash & Disconnect Resilience:** Zero reliance on an active internet connection to ring up sales, issue refunds, scan barcodes, or print receipts.
- **Conflict Resolution Engine:** Deterministic timestamp vector clocks prevent double-deduction or data corruption when syncing back to the cloud.
- **Hardware Integration:**
  - Standard ESC/POS Thermal Receipt Printers (80mm / 58mm) over Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, Ethernet, and USB.
  - Continuous Barcode & 2D DataMatrix/QR Scanners.
  - Automatic cash drawer triggers (RJ11/RJ12 pulses).

### 2.3 Mobile Parts & Electronics Industry Platform
- **Complex Hierarchical Categorization:** Tailored taxonomy for smartphone screens (OEM, OLED, Incell, TFT), IC chips (Power IC, Audio IC, Baseband), flex cables, cameras, batteries, and charging ports.
- **Model Compatibility Cross-Indexing:** Automated cross-referencing ensuring compatible components across phone generations and regional variants are easily discoverable.
- **Repair Ticket & Warranty Management:** Customer device intake with pattern lock records, initial diagnostic checklists, technician assignment, status updates via WhatsApp/SMS, and post-repair warranty expiration tracking.
